newsitem.title: USA: John Phillips dies, ex-First Boston muni official.
newsitem.headline: John Phillips dies, ex-First Boston muni official.

text.p: John Phillips, who spent his career at First Boston Corp's municipal bond department before retiring in 1989, died in St Bartholomew's, Guadeloupe, on Sunday of a heart attack. He was 64.
Mr Phillips was a vice president in the Municipal Bond Department of First Boston, retiring after 30 years in 1989. He was active in his career in the Municipal Bond Club of New York.

Phillips was a graduate of Phillips Exeter, class of 1951, and Yale University, Class of 1955. Following graduation, he entered the U.S. Army and served for two years as a captain in the artillery, based in Aschaffenburg, Germany.

A wake will be held at the Edwin L. Bennett Funeral Home, 824 Scarsdale Avenue, in Scarsdale, N.Y., from 7:00 p.m. to 9:00 p.m. on Friday, January 24. A funeral mass will be held on Saturday at 11:00 a.m. at Immaculate Heart of Mary Church in Scarsdale.
The family requests in lieu of flowers that donations be sent to the Church at Point O'Woods, Point of Woods, Fire Island, New York, 11706.
Mr Phillips is survived by his wife Barbara of 32 years, a daughter Julia and a son James; and three brothers.
